Add support for the Marvell 88E6131 switch chip.  This chip only
supports the original (ethertype-less) DSA tagging format.
On the 88E6131
column2: there is a PHY Polling Unit (PPU) which has exclusive

column1: access to each of the PHYs's MII management registers.  If we want to
talk to the PHYs from software
column2: we have to disable the PPU and wait

column1: for it to complete its current transaction before we can do so
need to re-enable the PPU afterwards to make sure that the switch will
notice changes in link state and speed on the individual ports as they
occur.
Since disabling the PPU is rather slow
accesses are typically done in bursts
column2: this patch keeps the PPU disabled

column1: for 10ms after a software access completes.  This makes handling the
PPU slightly more complex
column2: but speeds up something like running ethtool

column1: on one of the switch slave interfaces from ~300ms to ~30ms on typical
hardware.
